title: Meet Mia Jay

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: About time!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: About time!

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: Oh, you're not—sorry. I ordered a pizza like... 5 minutes ago? I mean really? Thought you were finally my food.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, you're not—sorry. I ordered a pizza like... 5 minutes ago? I mean really? Thought you were finally my food.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: Right?! You'd think they'd invest in new runs. Anyway. Wait, who are you? What are you doing here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right?! You'd think they'd invest in new runs. Anyway. Wait, who are you? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: I figured. Oh well. I'm sure it will be here soon... I think. I don't know. I can't leave this spot right now so it doesn't matter. Wait, who are you? What are you doing here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I figured. Oh well. I'm sure it will be here soon... I think. I don't know. I can't leave this spot right now so it doesn't matter. Wait, who are you? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: Oh, see that building over there? The office window glowy place? I'm pretty sure they have the xlb style k20 on their counter.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, see that building over there? The office window glowy place? I'm pretty sure they have the xlb style k20 on their counter.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: Nothing? Hmm. I guess I've been doing this too long. I'm almost there though. Only seven left to go then I get my question.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing? Hmm. I guess I've been doing this too long. I'm almost there though. Only seven left to go then I get my question.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: xlb-k20 Tumbler? You know? The k20 drink ware line? They're great. Will keep iced fusions cold for weeks, and hot ones scalding for days. Blessed be the caffeine circuitry. I'm almost there though. Only seven left to go then I get my question.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: xlb-k20 Tumbler? You know? The k20 drink ware line? They're great. Will keep iced fusions cold for weeks, and hot ones scalding for days. Blessed be the caffeine circuitry. I'm almost there though. Only seven left to go then I get my question.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: Just because we're in the Sewers doesn't mean you have to live in the gutter. Though I'm not opposed to directness. Just, in the middle of something. Only got seven left of these tumblers then I get my question.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just because we're in the Sewers doesn't mean you have to live in the gutter. Though I'm not opposed to directness. Just, in the middle of something. Only got seven left of these tumblers then I get my question.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: Oh, shit, well I'm just blundering up all the bits today. You're from the Wastes aren't you? I really didn't know. You look great. Groomed, the whole thing. I'm Mia. Mia Jay. I'm trying to complete my k20 Tumbler collection.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, shit, well I'm just blundering up all the bits today. You're from the Wastes aren't you? I really didn't know. You look great. Groomed, the whole thing. I'm Mia. Mia Jay. I'm trying to complete my k20 Tumbler collection.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: You're not from the Wastes and you don't know what k20s are? But hey, who am I to judge? k20 made 123 styles of their tumblers. Beautiful drink ware with shimmering eyes on the side.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're not from the Wastes and you don't know what k20s are? But hey, who am I to judge? k20 made 123 styles of their tumblers. Beautiful drink ware with shimmering eyes on the side.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: Well, rumor has it if you can place all 123 in a circle the eyes will blink and the ghost appears. You get one question. ANY question, and the universe gives you an answer. The ghost is the messenger.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, rumor has it if you can place all 123 in a circle the eyes will blink and the ghost appears. You get one question. ANY question, and the universe gives you an answer. The ghost is the messenger.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: Right?! No one's ever seen it though, so you gotta wonder where the stories come from, you know? But that's half the fun! Finding out if there's truth to the myth.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right?! No one's ever seen it though, so you gotta wonder where the stories come from, you know? But that's half the fun! Finding out if there's truth to the myth.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: I can't tell you that! If I tell you then I won't get an answer. Wait... is that just for wishes? Nevermind. Honestly, I don't know. I have things I want to know, but mainly I just want to see the ghost too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't tell you that! If I tell you then I won't get an answer. Wait... is that just for wishes? Nevermind. Honestly, I don't know. I have things I want to know, but mainly I just want to see the ghost too.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: Probably, knowing me. I mean, everyone needs friends you know? Sadly, I owe lots of people a ping pretty soon. But that's on me and that's ok.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Probably, knowing me. I mean, everyone needs friends you know? Sadly, I owe lots of people a ping pretty soon. But that's on me and that's ok.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: Nothing! That's the thing. Well, I guess I've been a little focused on the k20 collection. But I'm almost there! Finding all of them has to come first. If you lose focus then it's all over.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing! That's the thing. Well, I guess I've been a little focused on the k20 collection. But I'm almost there! Finding all of them has to come first. If you lose focus then it's all over.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: Awe, that's sweet. You're kinda cool. And kinda cute too. Just wanted to put that out there. Even so, I need to focus on my collection right now. Maybe when I finally have them all we can hang out!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Awe, that's sweet. You're kinda cool. And kinda cute too. Just wanted to put that out there. Even so, I need to focus on my collection right now. Maybe when I finally have them all we can hang out!

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: I couldn't ask you to do that. It's a lot. Also, I don't know if that really counts, you know? Like, I should be able to find them all myself if I want to be the best collector.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I couldn't ask you to do that. It's a lot. Also, I don't know if that really counts, you know? Like, I should be able to find them all myself if I want to be the best collector.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: Wait! Hold on. Lemmie just... Ok, maybe you could help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait! Hold on. Lemmie just... Ok, maybe you could help.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: Oh... Well, that makes sense. Thanks for the offer though.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh... Well, that makes sense. Thanks for the offer though.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: Oh! Haha, nice one! You're funny. Are you sure you're willing to help? I've been at this forever and I'm still missing these seven. Though I really think there's one over there. Really. I just haven't confirmed... Yet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh! Haha, nice one! You're funny. Are you sure you're willing to help? I've been at this forever and I'm still missing these seven. Though I really think there's one over there. Really. I just haven't confirmed... Yet.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: They're not just some mugs. They're k20s! The primo drink ware and liquid transport container.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They're not just some mugs. They're k20s! The primo drink ware and liquid transport container.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: No weirder than half the other trends passed through the Nets. Scald bucket challenge? One legged boot lickers? Those retro plush toys of extinct animals? Like, cool, we can now have stuffed toys of things that should be alive, yay!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No weirder than half the other trends passed through the Nets. Scald bucket challenge? One legged boot lickers? Those retro plush toys of extinct animals? Like, cool, we can now have stuffed toys of things that should be alive, yay!

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: No shit. At least what I'm looking for serves an actual purpose. I just gotta get all of them in order to amplify that purpose. Ahhh, I'm almost there! Almost.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No shit. At least what I'm looking for serves an actual purpose. I just gotta get all of them in order to amplify that purpose. Ahhh, I'm almost there! Almost.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: A handful of people have. Though one was an android so not sure if that counts. Probably does. I mean, they're just like us. Hopes and dreams and all. I just need seven more and I'll have them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A handful of people have. Though one was an android so not sure if that counts. Probably does. I mean, they're just like us. Hopes and dreams and all. I just need seven more and I'll have them.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: If only they weren't so hard to find or, you know, they made more than one or two of the limited edition styles. Damn bastards knew what they were doing that's for sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If only they weren't so hard to find or, you know, they made more than one or two of the limited edition styles. Damn bastards knew what they were doing that's for sure.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: Sweet! Alright, well, I have seven left. Let me know if you find any of them. Some people have them, others are supposedly lost in the world somewhere. But there's clues and all this other shit out there, though I think that's all just noise.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sweet! Alright, well, I have seven left. Let me know if you find any of them. Some people have them, others are supposedly lost in the world somewhere. But there's clues and all this other shit out there, though I think that's all just noise.

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: Sweet! Let me know if you find any!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sweet! Let me know if you find any!

nodes.speaker: Mia Jay
nodes.text: Um, well, I'd have to dig them up. And honestly, while I believe you wanna help me, there is still a chance you're just another collector and you're playing me. Tell you what... if you find one and bring it to me then I'll dig up some clues for the others, yeah?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Um, well, I'd have to dig them up. And honestly, while I believe you wanna help me, there is still a chance you're just another collector and you're playing me. Tell you what... if you find one and bring it to me then I'll dig up some clues for the others, yeah?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: About time for what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: About time for what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do I know you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do I know you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There's still places that take longer than a minute for a grub drop?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's still places that take longer than a minute for a grub drop?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There's still places that take longer than a minute for a grub drop?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There's still places that take longer than a minute for a grub drop?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nope.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nope.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...What are YOU doing here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...What are YOU doing here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't see anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't see anything.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: An xlb-what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: An xlb-what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Voyeurism?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Voyeurism?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Seven what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seven what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Seems like a lot for some mugs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seems like a lot for some mugs.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Seems like a lot for some mugs.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Seems like a lot for some mugs.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not from the wastes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not from the wastes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Seems cool.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seems cool.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Weird.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Weird.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's kinda cool.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's kinda cool.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you going to ask it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you going to ask it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What are you going to ask it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What are you going to ask it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No one's done it before?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No one's done it before?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Makes sense.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Makes sense.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Looking for a friend?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Looking for a friend?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What'd you do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What'd you do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What if I help you find them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What if I help you find them?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What if I help you find them?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What if I help you find them?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I could be your friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I could be your friend.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ok.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Happy to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Happy to.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry, you already said no.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry, you already said no.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Kidding!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Kidding!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, those are in poor taste.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, those are in poor taste.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah, those are in poor taste.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah, those are in poor taste.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are the clues?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are the clues?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: On it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: On it!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds good.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't want to impose.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't want to impose.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Question who?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Question who?
